description: Fix all 7 issues identified in the 2025-07-13-review-v1.md: (1) cross-kind comparison bug, (2) dict/set missing from dynamic dispatch, (3) TypedArray truthiness gap, (4) isDynamic predicate duplication, (5) error-path test coverage, (6) iterableElem duplication, (7) unary operators not dynamicized.
steps: Step 1 - Fix cross-kind comparison: add type-homogeneity guard in dynCmp before numeric catch-all
Step 2 - Add dict/set support to dynamic dispatch functions (dynLength, dynIterator, dynIndex, dynIn, dynTruth)
Step 3 - Fix dynTruth TypedArray handling using hostabi.ArrayElems
Step 4 - Consolidate isDynamic into types.IsDynamic exported function
Step 6 - Consolidate iterableElem into one canonical location
Step 7 - Dynamicize unary operators (-x, +x, not x) on Any/Union
acceptance_criteria: Error-path tests cover division by zero, index out of range, type-incompatible operations
Unary -/+/not on Any-typed values work correctly
